top5.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $43.9 billion
top5.description: CrowdStrike announced the all-stock acquisition of Zscaler, bringing together endpoint protection, zero-trust networking, cloud security and threat intelligence. Jay Chaudhry will remain CEO of Zscaler and join CrowdStrike’s board of directors.
top5.why: CrowdStrike’s proposed $43.9 billion acquisition of Zscaler would reshape the cybersecurity market by combining endpoint, cloud, network and threat-intelligence businesses.

top5.title: U.S. plans to sanction a smuggler of Nvidia chips to China
top5.description: The United States plans to place Megaspeed, a Singaporean data center company, on a blacklist for helping smuggle AI-related Nvidia chips into China. The company would then be barred from buying or selling goods in the United States.
top5.why: U.S. sanctions against a company accused of smuggling Nvidia chips to China show that export controls are expanding enforcement and could further constrain China’s access to advanced AI hardware.

top5.title: AI server makers raise prices by up to 45%
top5.description: AI server manufacturers are raising their prices by up to 45% after contracts are signed, according to the Financial Times.
top5.why: AI server price increases of up to 45% signal worsening infrastructure costs and could pressure AI companies’ margins, capacity plans and valuations.

top5.title: Google observes attacks that discover and exploit vulnerabilities without humans
top5.description: Google’s Threat Intelligence group reported for the first time that attackers were using AI to find and exploit software vulnerabilities without human intervention.
top5.why: Google’s observation of AI systems autonomously finding and exploiting vulnerabilities indicates that cyberattacks are becoming faster and less dependent on human operators.

top5.title: Anthropic and OpenAI employees question the safety of upcoming models
top5.description: More than two dozen sources report that employees at both companies doubt their most powerful unpublished models can be deployed safely. Nothing has been decided yet.
top5.why: Employees at OpenAI and Anthropic reportedly questioning whether upcoming frontier models can be deployed safely could trigger slower releases, stronger oversight and renewed regulatory pressure.
